tutorials.title: Introduction
tutorials.description: Learn the workshop story, key terms, and the role-based Staff pattern.

tutorials.title: Getting Started
tutorials.description: Open ChatGPT and prepare a private Staff Room called My AI Staff.

tutorials.title: Lab 1: Choose Your Task
tutorials.description: Select one repeat task, define success, and choose the smallest useful group of roles.

tutorials.title: Lab 2: Build The Staff
tutorials.description: Create three to five role-based agents with clear responsibilities and guardrails.

tutorials.title: Lab 3: Run The Staff Together
tutorials.description: Pass a safe practice request through the roles using visible handoffs and owner approval.

tutorials.title: Lab 4: Final Quiz
tutorials.description: Review the Staff design, safe stops, response variation, and the path to Oracle.
